boundaries: Kinematic wave relations and rational geometric-optics forms only; physical optics (interference, diffraction, polarization) is excluded.
Trigonometric forms (Snell refraction angles, Malus, critical angle) and logarithmic forms (decibels, magnitude scales) must be deferred with sources, never approximated.
Beat frequency is excluded unless stated one-sided; absolute value is not an engine operation.
Medium properties (wave speed, refractive index) are supplied inputs with stated medium and conditions, never assumed.
Expressions must be written in canonical base units of the runtime registry; never inline a conversion factor that belongs to unit scales (see the canonical-units rule).
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: New meanings (wave_speed, wave_frequency, wave_period, wavelength, focal_length, object_distance, image_distance, magnification and similar) and units (Hz, kHz, MHz) require extension; all seed forms are scalar rational arithmetic and fit the engine once meanings exist.
mission: Curate atomic reusable algebraic wave and optics relationships: wave kinematics, thin-lens imaging and Doppler shift, each with explicit medium and sign-convention scope. Scalar arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Wave speed from frequency and wavelength
Thin-lens image distance from focal length and object distance
Transverse magnification from image and object distances
Observed frequency for a source moving toward a stationary observer in a stated medium
special_checks: State the sign convention (real-is-positive or Cartesian) in every lens/magnification record
Guard nonzero frequency, wavelength, focal length and the Doppler denominator (no sonic-boom singularity)
Test a boundary case (object at focal point rejected, zero relative motion gives zero shift)
Distinguish the kinematic relation from any energy, intensity or perceptual claim
